metadata.scenario: A new mother calls asking about post-partum doula services. She had a C-section two weeks ago and needs help with breastfeeding support and newborn care while she recovers. The receptionist explains their mother-baby program and availability. The caller wants to start next week. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I assist you today? Hi, my name is Emily, and I just had a C-section two weeks ago. I’m looking for postpartum support. Congratulations on your new baby, Emily! We do offer postpartum doula services. That’s great! I need help with breastfeeding support and newborn care while I recover. Absolutely, our mother-baby program focuses on both breastfeeding support and infant care. How does it work? Our doulas can assist you for about 2-4 hours per visit, helping with breastfeeding techniques, diaper changes, and soothing the baby. That sounds perfect. What are the costs involved? The price for postpartum doula services is between $70 to $90 per visit, depending on the duration. Okay, I think that’s manageable. Are you available next week? Let me check our availability. When are you looking for help? Ideally, I’d like someone to come in on Tuesday and Thursday next week. I see. We do have openings on both those days. Would you prefer a morning or afternoon visit? Mornings would be best for me. Perfect! I’ll schedule you for Tuesday and Thursday mornings. Thank you! Will the same doula come both days? Yes, I'll assign the same doula so you can have consistency in your care. That sounds great. I’ll also need to confirm some information for our records. Can I have your address? Sure, it’s 123 Maple Street, Wichita, KS 67205. Thank you. And could I get a contact number? Yes, it’s +13165551234. Great! That’s all set. I’ll send you an email confirmation with the details. Thank you! Is there any paperwork I need to complete? Yes, I’ll include a couple of forms in the email for you to fill out before the first visit. Okay, I will look out for that. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything. Thank you so much for your help! You’re very welcome, Emily! We look forward to assisting you and your baby next week. Thanks! Have a great day. You too! Goodbye.
